mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS spot_id, s.type AS type, s.name AS name, ST_Latitude(s.location) AS lat, ST_Longitude(s.location) AS lng, s.address AS address, s.weather_nx AS weather_nx, s.weather_ny AS weather_ny, s.park_warning AS park_warning, pa.name AS area_name, pa.source AS area_source, pa.source_date AS area_source_date, b.description AS description, b.has_water AS has_water, b.has_toilet AS has_toilet, b.signal_level AS signal_level, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bakji_confirmation c WHERE c.spot_id = s.id) AS confirmation_count, b.reporter_id AS reporter_id, m.nickname AS reporter_nickname, d.source AS source, d.category AS category, d.facilities AS facilities, d.phone AS phone, d.homepage AS homepage, d.source_date AS source_date, d.operating_status AS operating_status, d.closed_from AS closed_from, d.closed_until AS closed_until FROM spot s LEFT JOIN public_spot_detail d ON d.spot_id = s.id LEFT JOIN bakji_detail b ON b.spot_id = s.id LEFT JOIN member m ON m.id = b.reporter_id LEFT JOIN protected_area pa ON pa.id = s.protected_area_id WHERE s.id = #{spotId} AND s.status = 'ACTIVE'
